recognitionRules: Use plain Arial with strong declarative slide titles.
Keep source and study scope in a stable lower text area.
Pair What happened and What remains untested as equally legible columns.
Reserve teal for the proposal or evidence route, not for overstating confidence.

writingLinks.name: Research register
writingLinks.reason: Bounded finding presented live with its uncertainty and decision records.

quote: Here is what happened in the study, and what the study cannot yet tell us.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use ATLAS LIVE EVIDENCE in Arial with a small study ID after a slash. No waveform or live-broadcast symbol.
invariants: Use plain Arial with strong declarative slide titles.
Keep source and study scope in a stable lower text area.
Pair What happened and What remains untested as equally legible columns.
adaptations: A recording version retains scope text at readable size.
A handout can add detail after the spoken proposition, not inside the title.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
